title: config/checklist.json
description: The checklists that the push gate, the guard of the full run and the document check read, and the Git hooks that a checkout installs.

hooks.description: The tracked hooks of .githooks that every checkout installs; pre-push is required and runs the push gate.

trackers.description: The checklists: documents whose items carry a state. An item in the active state stops a push and a full run.

path.description: The English document, relative to the repository root.

translation.description: The Korean twin of the document, which must hold the same item IDs and states; the document check reads it with the same rules.

format.description: table: a row `| ID | ... | state |`; list: an item `- [state] ID text`.

idPattern.description: The source of the regular expression that a task ID matches as a whole; a letter followed by letters, digits, . and - when absent.

column.description: The zero-based cell of a table row that holds the state; the last cell when absent.

states.description: Every state that an item may have; a state outside the list is an error. Any state is accepted when absent.

active.description: The state that stops a push and a full run, written as the document writes it, for example [~].
